narr: Another influx of monsoon moisture fueled scattered thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. One storm produced flash flooding.
ev: Hackberry Road was closed from Highway 66 to Main Street due to flooding.
lsr: Mohave County roads reports closure of S Hackberry Road from HWY 66 to E Main due to flooding. Nearby Truxton Canyon USGS gage reports 7 foot water rise within the wash.
